title.suggested: Joe Coburn Offers to Back McCoole Against Allen

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted from a Nevada paper Joe Coburn's offer to back Mike McCoole against Tom Allen for $5,000 to $10,000 under London rules, anywhere in the United States, with Coburn as trainer.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'Daily Democrat. Wednesday Morning, July 7, 1869.' This is before the 1875 merger, so it is not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: Joe Coburn offered to back Mike McCoole against Allen in a 24-foot ring under the latest London rules for $5,000 to $10,000, anywhere in the United States, within sixty days of signing, with Coburn as McCoole's trainer and first second

notes: The manifesto first appeared in an unnamed Nevada paper; its date is not given, so the fact date is the month of the reprint.
